name: Does hard water in the Las Vegas area affect reverse osmosis filter life?

mainEntity.name: Does hard water in the Las Vegas area affect reverse osmosis filter life?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, hard water prevalent in the Las Vegas area can significantly impact the lifespan of your reverse osmosis filters, particularly the RO membrane. Minerals like calcium and magnesium contribute to scale buildup, which can prematurely clog filters and reduce the membrane's efficiency. Regular replacement of pre-filters is crucial to protect the RO membrane from this mineral load. CG Plumbing Solutions understands the local water conditions and can advise on optimal filter replacement schedules to combat hard water effects.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hard water in Las Vegas can shorten RO filter life due to mineral buildup; regular pre-filter changes are essential to protect the RO membrane.
